svg.text: STAGE 526 · TOPIC 166 · P1045–P1046 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 170TH SVG & 1,055TH GUARDRAIL DUAL MILESTONE!
Enterprise WebRTC/RTP RFC 8843 BUNDLE mid Demux & Payload Type Collision Guard
Deterministic Intra-BUNDLE Unique PT + sdes:mid Demux (P1045) & BUNDLE-tag Shared Transport + [1, 16]B mid Bounds (P1046 🎉)
❌ UNPROTECTED RFC 8843 BUNDLE DEMUX
1. Intra-BUNDLE PT Collision & Missing sdes:mid
m=audio PT=96 (Opus) + m=video PT=96 (VP8) in same BUNDLE
• 17 VP8 video packets misrouted into AI Opus audio decoder
• 20 bundled m= sections in oneSDP offer trigger parser inflation
2. Orphan Port Leak & 48B mid Header Overflow
Secondary m= lines allocate 6 unbundled TURN relay ports
• Rejected first m= section desyncs BUNDLE-tag transport address
• 48-byte mid token overflows RFC 8285 1-byte header extension (16B)
Production Impact Without P1045 / P1046 🎉
• White-noise blasts & ASR/Opus crashes from cross-track PT collisions
• 3x TURN relay port exhaustion & mid-renegotiation audio blackholes
✅ STAGE 526 DETERMINISTIC GUARDRAILS (P1045–P1046 🎉)
P1045 (1,054th Guard): Unique Intra-BUNDLE PT & mid Demux
action: "enforce_unique_bundle_payload_types_and_mid_demux"
• Enforces disjoint PT numbers across distinct codecs + sdes:mid
• Clamps crossTrackPtCollisionOrMisroutedPackets = 0
• Clamps bundledMediaSectionsCount in [1, 8] (20 -> 8 tracks)
Policy ID: P1045-WEBRTC-RFC8843-BUNDLE-UNIQUE-PAYLOAD-TYPE-AND-MID-DEMUX-PRIORITY-GUARD
P1046 🎉 (1,055th Guard & 170th SVG 🎉): BUNDLE-tag & [1, 16]B mid
action: "converge_bundle_tag_shared_transport_and_clamp_mid_bytes"
• Converges bundled m= sections to active BUNDLE-tag transport
• Clamps leakedOrphanBundlePortsOrDesyncedTracksCount = 0
• Clamps midIdentificationTagByteLength in [1, 16]B (48B -> 16B)
Policy ID: P1046-WEBRTC-RFC8843-BUNDLE-ONLY-PORT-ZERO-AND-SHARED-TRANSPORT-ADDRESS-GUARD
